_note: wave50-B12 hand verdicts. Method, seed and the severity rule are in README.md beside this file. Population: every PASSING scored cell of tools/titan/runs/wave49-final (the scorer idiom verbatim). Each cell was opened as a [capture|reference] composite plus a magnified crop of the divergent bounding box, and every verdict is backed by a measured number quoted in its note. The sample is uncorrelated with any image metric by construction, which is what obligation #4 needs of a defect set.
